text:
Maya: FYI CI marketplace smoke surfaced a reproducible perf delta on CUDA 12.4 + driver 540.2 for p4d instances. Notable latency regression on long-context chat workload in us-east-1. tagging @Owen @Harpreet.
Owen: Can you paste the minimal repro and the perf numbers? quick check helps prioritize.
Maya: Repro gist:
```
# run on canary image
python bench_chat.py --model redwood-mini --seq 3072 --batch 1 --device cuda
# result: median latency=980ms, baseline median=620ms
```
Maya: Also seeing some gpumem spikes leading to retries in our SDK. No kernel oops so far.
Harpreet: Partner rolled out a microkernel update bundled with driver 540.2 last week. Might be missing a CUDA ABI shim for our runtime. Could be a scheduling regression too.
Owen: Proposal: pin marketplace image driver to 538.85 temporarily and create a named hotfix image tag `r-inference-538-stable` for marketplace. Also add a short-term runtime fallback flag to enable older kernel path.
partner-liaison: I'll notify partner PMs and ask for immediate rollback guidance and changelog. We need clear customer comms if we push pins.
infra-bot: Canary deployment request accepted (id: deploy-2026-03-22-773). Canary lanes: us-east-1, eu-west-1. Telemetry channel: #marketplace-canaries.
Maya: Triage plan:
  1) Build hotfix manifest pinning driver 538.85 and tag images with `r-inference:538-stable`.
  2) Push to canary lanes and run perf harness (seq=3072, batch=1) with target median < 700ms.
  3) If canary passes, roll to staged lane and schedule full rollout with partner approval.
  4) Draft customer-facing note and internal incident stub.
Owen: Add rollback snippets to runbook. Quick manifest patch:
```
# manifest patch
yq e '.nodeConfig.driverVersion = "538.85"' marketplace/manifest.yaml > marketplace/manifest.538.yaml
ci push-manifest --manifest marketplace/manifest.538.yaml --lane canary
```
Harpreet: Also recommend we run a micro-benchmark that exercises stream kernel vs tensorRT fallback path to isolate which path regressed.
partner-liaison: I'll coordinate partner comms. If they recommend a fast patch instead of rollback, please include instruction to opt-in to the patch-based driver in the manifest.
Maya: infra-bot reported canary build started. Will wait for telemetry and share perf graphs. Holding comms until we confirm canary signal. :eyes:
infra-bot: Canary telemetry: median latency in us-east-1 canary=640ms (vs target <700ms), eu-west-1 canary=655ms. Memory spike reduced on canary images.
Owen: Looks good. Proceed to staged lane and prepare comms. Also create a postmortem template and add a follow-up item to add automated driver compatibility checks in marketplace CI.
Harpreet: We'll request partner to include a compatibility matrix with next driver patch and share kernel diffs. Also adding a flag for early adopter customers who want experimental drivers.
partner-liaison: Sending partner note now. Will include rollback instructions, canary telemetry, and ask for root-cause ETA. Looping SI contacts.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Moving to staged rollout and opening incident ticket for tracking. :white_check_mark:
